cues: The partly filled d orbitals and unsatisfied valencies on a metal surface adsorb gas molecules, hold them close together in the right orientation, and weaken their bonds.
In the Haber process, nitrogen and hydrogen are adsorbed on iron, the strong nitrogen triple bond is loosened, and ammonia forms and leaves.
